app.title: Family Splitter
app.description: A shared space for five family members to track travel and property expenses, with separate USD and MXN balances.

auth.loginDescription: Use your family email address to receive a magic link. No password needed.
auth.genericResponse: If this email is registered with your family, a sign-in link will arrive shortly.
auth.unconfigured: Please contact the person setting up your family’s account.
auth.invalidLink: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
auth.denied: This account cannot access the family. Sign out and use your registered family email.
auth.unavailable: We could not check your family access. Try again.
auth.signOutFailed: We could not sign you out. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Your family space
